description: How much of its context window a session's agent last said it's used (Claude Code's get_context_usage answer, Codex's token count, pi-claude's count of what it sends), kept by its host: asked of its agent as it starts, through a turn (at most once a second), as the turn ends, after a compaction and after its model's changed, and kept while its agent's stopped. Every app's context meter shows it.

totalTokens.description: The tokens its conversation takes up now; null where its agent hasn't said.

maxTokens.description: Its model's window, in tokens; null or 0 where its agent doesn't know it.

showWithoutLimit.description: Shown though there's no window (Codex's before it says one): the tokens used alone.

categories.description: What the tokens are, as its agent splits them (its meter's tooltip).
